title: Adapter Specification
description: Schema for the language-neutral Adapter Specification YAML emitted by the read-skill suite. Validated against all 40 goldens (21 Go + 19 Java) in `prebid-server-{go,java}/read/test-fixtures/`. Versioned independently from behavior-taxonomy.yaml and port-translation-rules.yaml; see CHANGELOG.md.

adapter_spec_version.description: Schema version this spec conforms to. SemVer string per ADR-001 D7. The 40 existing goldens declare '1.0.0'; '1.1.0' admits the ADR-007 F1/F3/F4/F5 $defs (EndpointResolution, EntityStrategy, BidPostProcessing, ImpExtUnmarshal). Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b lands as '1.2.0' (MINOR): closes 17 accidentally-open additionalProperties:true sites, lifts 4 top-level open-maps to structured $defs (SpringConfig/BidderClass/CodeNaming/Lifecycle plus 10 nested item shapes), closes 8 round-2 sweep sites under code.* and cross_language.*, and tightens if/then invariants for Go specs and Java alias specs. Phase D0.2 lands as '1.3.0' (MINOR): admits optional cross_language.java_artifacts.bidder_params_path for the rare bidders whose Java upstream filename diverges from the lowercase bidder name (adkerneladn → adkernelAdn.json camelCase; emxdigital → emx_digital.json snake_case). All existing goldens continue to validate (per `docs/methodology/schema-versioning.md` MINOR criteria). 2.0.0 is a MAJOR: `bidder_params_json` is REMOVED and `bidder_params_ref` is required. The inline field was the reader's own transcription of the upstream file and `bidder_params_sha256` hashed it, so a lossy transcription produced a self-consistent digest and passed R2 -- two beachfront goldens did exactly that. The ref names the upstream path and commit and carries both a sha256 and a byte length, so the bytes are re-derivable and the reader is no longer its own witness. Migration: scripts/migrate/1.3.0-to-2.0.0.py.

bidder_params_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the upstream bytes. Mirrors `bidder_params_ref.sha256`; kept top-level because the 17 dual-spec assertion files key cross-language byte-divergence on it. Derived, not independent -- R2a checks the pair.

params.description: Null on alias-only specs (e.g., 152media-Java) where the alias inherits parent's params.

code.description: Null on alias-only specs where the alias inherits parent's adapter code.

tests.description: Null on alias-only specs that don't carry their own test inventory.

aliases.description: Rich alias metadata block. Per-alias entry on Java goldens; can be empty list on Go goldens that don't list aliases.

code_naming.description: ADR-001 D1: top-level Java-only block (NOT nested under code.naming).

lifecycle.description: ADR-001 D5: top-level lifecycle block. Currently only `rename` is emitted; future lifecycle event kinds (merge, split, etc.) would slot in alongside.

registry.description: ADR-001 D6: present on Java goldens that record test-application.properties registry. Open-map; Wave 11c C3 will move to tests.test_application_properties.* with proper $defs (deferred from Wave 11b's B6 closure pass — corpus-coupled migration requires its own ADR-001 amendment).

taxonomy_version.description: ADR-001 D7: SemVer string for behavior taxonomy version goldens conform to.

bidder_params_ref.description: Reference to the upstream bidder-params file instead of a transcription of it. R2 used to hash `bidder_params_json` -- the reader's own output -- so a lossy transcription produced a self-consistent hash that no hermetic gate could see (two beachfront goldens carried text that was never upstream). A ref cannot be elided: `sha256` and `bytes` are properties of the upstream bytes, and `bytes` in particular cannot be derived from text the reader wrote. The bytes themselves live in the content-addressed blob store at read/test-fixtures/blobs/<sha256> so offline consumers keep byte access.

resolved_commit.description: The commit these bytes were read at -- the golden's own pin.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the upstream bytes at resolved_commit.

bytes.description: Byte length. Second, independent witness: a length cannot survive an elision the way a re-hashed transcription can.

then.description: Go-source spec invariants per ADR-001: Java-only blocks must be null. spring_config and bidder_class are wholly Java-specific (Spring DI / class hierarchy). code_naming and registry are also Java-only — Go corpus walk confirms zero non-null emissions for either. lifecycle.rename remains bilateral (e.g., elementaltv-Go has lifecycle.rename for the Adoppler→ElementalTV rename).

Java-source spec invariants per ADR-001: spring_config and bidder_class are non-null on non-alias goldens. lifecycle and code_naming are populated when relevant; otherwise null. Aliases (meta.is_alias=true) are exempt — they're permitted to null these blocks.

anyOf.description: Non-alias Java spec: spring_config and bidder_class must be present (non-null).
Alias Java spec (meta.is_alias=true): spring_config and bidder_class MUST be null (inherited from parent; never emitted on the alias spec itself). 152media-Java is the canonical example.

skill_versions.description: Open map keyed by skill name (`orchestrator`, `read-adapter-code`, etc.); value is the SemVer string version.

empire_canonical_master.description: ADR-003 audit B6: marks parent or single representative spec as canonical Rule 44 master sample.

empire_parent_flavor.description: ADR-003 audit B6: Rule 44 sub-flavor inherited from empire parent.

kind.description: Accepts the UNION of bidder_info-scope and code-scope values. ADR-001 H3 documents the intended scope-distinct enums; tightening to the 9-value bidder_info-scope set is deferred to a future wave that fixes goldens currently mixing the two scopes (out of Wave 11b's closure-only scope).

user_sync.description: Open map: verbatim user_sync subtree from upstream YAML.

yaml_extra_fields.description: Open map of fields not in the canonical bidder-info schema.

oneOf.description: Structured quirk (adkernel-Go style). Common keys: field, observed_value, canonical_value, summary, observed.

yaml_field_name_quirks.description: Items are sometimes strings (free-text) and sometimes objects with structured fields. Phase 2.7 may normalize to one shape.

Code.description: Closed in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b; declared properties cover all corpus emissions.

EndpointResolution.description: ADR-007 F1: endpoint resolution mechanism for `code.make_requests.endpoint_resolution`. adapter_spec_version 1.1.0 admits the `multi-endpoint-by-mediatype` / `multi-endpoint-by-shape` kinds and the `endpoints[]` array. Wave 11b B3+ closed Code's outer shape and added a structured `MakeRequests` `$def` for the parent block; per-pattern `$ref`-wiring of THIS `$def` (EndpointResolution) into `MakeRequests.endpoint_resolution` is deferred to a future wave. Master sample: beachfront (banner + video endpoints).

endpoints.description: Populated when kind = multi-endpoint-*. Logical (declaration) order; not lex-sorted (per ADR-007 array ordering policy).

role.description: Free-text role tag (canonical: banner, video, adm, nurl).

EntityStrategy.description: ADR-007 F3: per-entity (Site/App/User) mutation strategy under `code.make_requests.mutation.entity_strategies`. adapter_spec_version 1.1.0 admits `replace-with-app-synthesis` / `synthesize-app-replacement` / `synthesize-from-site`. Wave 11b B3+ closed Code at the outer level; `MakeRequests.mutation.entity_strategies` is currently typed `object|null` (implicit-open under MakeRequests's structured $def). Per-pattern $ref-wiring of THIS $def (EntityStrategy) into the entity_strategies position is deferred to a future wave. Master sample: vungle (Site=replace-with-app-synthesis, App=synthesize-app-replacement).

BidPostProcessing.description: ADR-007 F4: post-decode mutation of bid fields (e.g., AUCTION_PRICE macro replacement in bid.NURL / bid.AdM / bid.BURL). Lives at `code.make_bids.bid_post_processing`. adapter_spec_version 1.1.0 admits the shape. Wave 11b B3+ closed Code at the outer level; the `code.make_bids` block has its own structured `MakeBids` $def now, but `bid_post_processing` is typed `object|null` within MakeBids — per-pattern $ref-wiring of THIS $def (BidPostProcessing) into MakeBids.bid_post_processing is deferred to a future wave. Master sample: thetradedesk.

macros.description: Logical (declaration) order; not lex-sorted (per ADR-007 array ordering policy).

fields.description: Bid-field paths the macro substitutes into (e.g., bid.NURL, bid.AdM, bid.BURL).

source.description: Where the substitution value comes from at runtime (e.g., bid.Price).

mechanism.description: How the substitution is performed (regex / token-replace / etc.).

ImpExtUnmarshal.description: ADR-007 F5: imp.ext unmarshal pattern + post-extraction strip flag. Lives at `code.make_requests.imp_ext_unmarshal`. adapter_spec_version 1.1.0 admits the `strip_post_extraction` flag. Wave 11b B3+ closed Code at the outer level; `code.make_requests.imp_ext_unmarshal` is typed `object|null` within MakeRequests's structured $def. Per-pattern $ref-wiring of THIS $def (ImpExtUnmarshal) into MakeRequests.imp_ext_unmarshal is deferred to a future wave. Master sample for strip_post_extraction: beintoo (zeroes out imp.Ext after parsing).

strip_post_extraction.description: ADR-007 F5: true when adapter zeroes out imp.Ext after parsing.

fixture_inventory.description: Open map keyed by category (exemplary, supplemental, amp, video, videosupplemental, integration, plus extension categories like extrainfo_exemplary).

unit_test_breakdown.description: ADR-001 D6: open map keyed by test class name, value is method count.

IabCategoryStorage.description: Closed in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b; `notes` admitted as declared property.

delivery_mechanism.description: ADR-001 D2: how the IAB category table is delivered to the adapter (Phase 2.7 renamed from `injection` to disambiguate from currency_conversion.injection).

custom_unmarshal.description: Closed in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b; `notes` admitted as declared property for goldens documenting branching strategies.

used.description: Null on alias specs where currency-conversion knowledge is inherited from parent.

language_stamped.description: ADR-007 F2: true when at least one header value differs by language at request time.

language_stamped_headers.description: ADR-007 F2: array kept in logical (declaration) order; not lex-sorted (audit C7).

on_alias.description: Alias name this deploy-time token applies to (when token is alias-scoped); null otherwise.

notes.description: Free-form prose; admitted as either a single string (literal block / scalar) or an array of strings.

Alias.description: Per-alias metadata for Java parent goldens that declare aliases (e.g., adkernel parent's 152media child). Open map; Wave 11c C1 will resolve the canonical name field decision (`bidder_name` vs `name`) — corpus-coupled, deferred from Wave 11b's closure pass to its own ADR-001 amendment.

config_form.description: ADR-005: tilde_inherit = `<name>: ~`; full_block = nested override block.

rename_origin.description: ADR-006: marks aliases that exist solely to provide backward-compat after a lifecycle rename.

relationship_flavor.description: ADR-003 audit B6: Rule 44 sub-flavor for this child's empire relationship.

SpringConfig.description: Closed in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b; Java-only Spring DI block.

configuration_properties_class.description: Either a class name (string, when bidder needs no structured properties), null (no SCP class), or a structured ConfigurationPropertiesClass.

ConfigurationPropertyNestedClass.description: Nested static class within a ConfigurationPropertiesClass. `visibility` (rubicon) and `access` (huaweiads) are golden-author variants for the same concept; both admitted. Same for `annotations` vs `lombok_annotations`.

BidderClass.description: Closed in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b; Java-only class hierarchy block.

Lifecycle.description: Closed in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b. Currently only `rename` event kind is emitted; round-1 audit confirmed no other event kinds in corpus.

CodeImports.description: Closed in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b round-2 sweep.

AdapterStruct.description: Closed in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b round-2 sweep.

CodeBuilder.description: Closed in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b round-2 sweep.

MakeRequests.description: Closed at top-level in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b round-2 sweep. Sub-object contents (batching.rules[*], endpoint_resolution, mutation, etc.) remain implicit-open per Draft 2020-12 default; future waves may tighten.

MakeBids.description: Closed at top-level in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b round-2 sweep. Sub-object contents remain implicit-open; future waves may tighten.

helpers.description: Parity with code.make_requests.helpers[] — currently no goldens emit this on the make_bids side, but the read-adapter-code SKILL.md references the path for forward-compat (parsers/utils helpers can attach to either caller).

GoArtifacts.description: Closed in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b round-2 sweep. Universal keys (bidder_constant, bidder_dir, package_name) plus per-bidder file-path artifacts (152media-Java emits 9 additional path keys describing its port artifacts).

bidder_params_path.description: Path to the upstream bidder-params JSON. Renamed from `bidder_params_json` at 2.0.0 to match `java_artifacts.bidder_params_path` and to stop one field name from meaning both a path and (formerly, at top level) the file's bytes. `bidder_params_ref.path` is the normative carrier; this records the path as the reader observed it.

JavaArtifacts.description: Closed in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b round-2 sweep. Phase D0.2 added optional `bidder_params_path` for the rare Java bidders whose upstream filename diverges from the lowercase bidder name (adkerneladn → adkernelAdn.json camelCase; emxdigital → emx_digital.json snake_case).

bidder_params_path.description: Path to the upstream bidder-params JSON. Populate when the filename diverges from `src/main/resources/static/bidder-params/{bidder}.json` (adkerneladn -> adkernelAdn.json camelCase; emxdigital -> emx_digital.json snake_case). Same field name as `go_artifacts.bidder_params_path` since 2.0.0. `bidder_params_ref.path` is the normative carrier.

PortConcerns.description: Closed in Phase 2.8 / Wave 11b round-2 sweep. All values boolean; each flag captures a known cross-language port concern category.

source_language.description: ADR-001 D3: 'shared-genesis' for pre-Go-Java pair convention bidders (canonical: rubicon).

destination_language.description: ADR-001 D3: matches source_language enum; shared-genesis admitted for pre-Go-Java pair convention bidders.
